problem: The v10 stability audit isolated four persistent failures where the correct document was repeatedly retrieved but the literal answer was absent from its preview. The existing obligation-span selector exposed three answers, but failed query 679 because a declarative multi-sentence question states the requested project in its first sentence while the v0 heuristic blindly treats the last contextual sentence as the answer obligation.
simplest_baseline: Keep answer_obligation_window_v0: use the last sentence containing a question mark, otherwise use the final sentence, then rank fixed-size windows by overlap.
hypothesis: A deterministic target-intent compiler that recognizes explicit answer requests such as 'I am seeking', 'what is', 'which', 'give', and 'name of' before falling back to v0 will preserve all three v0 span hits and expose the fourth answer without any provider, search, or Judge call.
changed_mechanisms: typed answer-obligation clause compiler for interrogative and declarative research questions
anti_claim: This gold-aware development oracle tests a deterministic parsing and span-availability precondition. It does not improve the frozen model or establish end-to-end benchmark gains.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: A planner can restate the task, but spawning a sub-agent is unnecessary when the measured error is deterministic selection of the wrong sentence as the requested answer clause.
Free-form decomposition is broader but harder to audit; this loop tests a smaller typed answer-obligation contract before any research graph changes.
Another planning call adds variance and Token cost; the observed clause-selection error can first be challenged with a deterministic compiler.
Graph expansion solves branch coverage, while this failure occurs before expansion because the requested answer node itself was misidentified.

frozen_controls: same retrieved gold documents and local document index
same 2,000-character span cap and window scorer
v0 selected spans retained as the baseline
next_action: Preserve the v1 parser as a typed utility but do not advance it as an effectiveness mechanism. The remaining q679 error is now localized to window ranking: the intended obligation explicitly names the acknowledgments section, yet generic term overlap selects an author-biography window. Test one deterministic section-anchor priority before any provider call.
claim_boundary: The four cases are outcome-selected and gold-aware. Even a 4/4 oracle pass would authorize only a monotonic-overlay calibration on these cases, not a fresh development, official, leaderboard, or model-capability claim.
